name: Zhejiang Yongtai Technology Co., Ltd. GDR Class A RegS
summary: Zhejiang Yongtai Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the production, research, development, sale, and service of medicines, pesticides, electronic chemicals, and new energy lithium battery materials. Its products include active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical intermediates, advanced intermediates, basic intermediates, pesticides, liquid crystal materials, and lithium battery materials. It also provides contract manufacturing services. The company was founded by Ying Mei Wang and Ren Bao He on October 11, 1999 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
